sketches.mechanism: An empty data type has no constructors, and an empty case expression is exhaustive because no value can exist to match.
sketches.resonance: Absence can justify any conclusion, but only because it can never arrive.

sketches.mechanism: NaN is the only standard numeric value for which self-inequality is true under !==.
sketches.resonance: A value becomes so indeterminate that it cannot even equal itself.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field removes that field rather than storing a nil value.
sketches.resonance: Some losses cannot be kept as contents; they erase the place that held them.
